verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Gitea has kanban-style project boards with columns/issues supporting milestones, due dates, dependencies, and time tracking, which covers day-to-day task organization, but there's no evidence of higher-level roadmap features (e.g., cross-repo project views, roadmap timelines) or any community validation of using boards for roadmap planning. Missing for 10: evidence of roadmap/timeline views, cross-project or organization-level board hierarchy, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the project board feature in practice.
